verdict.rationale: Algolia documents an official Crawler that extracts web page content into records (docs-12, docs-38, docs-51). It also offers official integrations for Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools, Salesforce B2C Commerce and Zendesk (docs-11). Managed ingestion keeps schedules, retries and transformations in the dashboard without deploying code (docs-48), and hands-on users report crawler-based DocSearch working with zero maintenance (comm-5, comm-15). Missing for 10: documented connectors for common databases/CMSs beyond the listed commerce platforms and Zendesk (one user needed a custom cloud function for Firebase), and crawler robustness on slow pages, where a user reports timeouts missing content (comm-12).
